**DNS on AWS Route 53:** a hosted zone per domain, the registrar's nameservers replaced with Route 53's, and records as data in the repository. Because of a nameserver issue on the .ai domain, the first version goes live on agenticcells.com; once agenticcells.ai serves, it becomes the home and .com redirects to it. The company site will be on GitHub Pages, from [AgentiCCell/AgentiCCell__Website](https://github.com/AgentiCCell/AgentiCCell__Website).[AgentiCCells/AgentiCCells__Website](https://github.com/AgentiCCells/AgentiCCells__Website). Each customer site will be a single CNAME record, never a wildcard, verified in our GitHub organisation, and deleted the day a customer leaves, so no subdomain can be taken over.
